mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO assistant_knowledge_chunk (doc_id, tenant_id, chunk_no, content, char_count, source, vector_id, create_time, deleted) VALUES
(#{item.docId}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.chunkNo}, #{item.content}, #{item.charCount}, #{item.source}, #{item.vectorId}, #{item.createTime}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.doc_id, c.tenant_id, c.chunk_no, c.content, c.char_count, c.source, c.vector_id, c.create_time, c.deleted FROM assistant_knowledge_chunk c INNER JOIN assistant_knowledge_doc d ON d.doc_id = c.doc_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.enabled = 1 AND d.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
